invariants.rationale: The method sets list's touchable property to disabled before returning.
selectBox is accessed at the end of the method and must be non-null to call onHide(this).
If hasParent() was false or list was not touchable, the method would return early.
list.getKeyListener() is used within the method, so it is likely non-null.
hideListener is passed into removeCaptureListener, so it must be non-null.
